arguments.content:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add a cover page to report.pdf with title and current date."""
import os
from datetime import date

from reportlab.lib.pagesizes import letter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas
from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

TITLE = "Annual Financial Report"
CURRENT_DATE = date.today().strftime("%B %d, %Y")
INPUT_PDF = "report.pdf"
COVER_PDF = "cover_page.pdf"
OUTPUT_PDF = "report_with_cover.pdf"

# 1. Create the cover page
c = canvas.Canvas(COVER_PDF, pagesize=letter)
width, height = letter

# Title centered on the page
c.setFont("Times-Bold", 28)
title_width = c.stringWidth(TITLE, "Times-Bold", 28)
c.drawString((width - title_width) / 2, height - 300, TITLE)

# Date below the title
c.setFont("Times-Roman", 18)
date_text = CURRENT_DATE
date_width = c.stringWidth(date_text, "Times-Roman", 18)
c.drawString((width - date_width) / 2, height - 340, date_text)

c.save()
print(f"Created cover page: {COVER_PDF}")

# 2. Merge the cover page with report.pdf
assert os.path.exists(INPUT_PDF), f"Missing input file: {INPUT_PDF}"

reader_report = PdfReader(INPUT_PDF)
reader_cover = PdfReader(COVER_PDF)

writer = PdfWriter()
writer.add_page(reader_cover.pages[0])
for page in reader_report.pages:
    writer.add_page(page)

with open(OUTPUT_PDF, "wb") as f:
    writer.write(f)

print(f"Created merged PDF: {OUTPUT_PDF} "
      f"(cover + {len(reader_report.pages)} report page(s))")
